data.name: ShowsHeroLead
data.value: We stage dances of witches, devils and other beasts with live music, fire and pyrotechnics. We offer different formats and storylines to adapt to every celebration.

data.name: ShowsIntro
data.value: We can classify our shows by type or duration, and we also work with several scripts and stories that we tailor to the needs of each event.

data.name: ShowsLargeDescription
data.value: Ideal to energise big venues and close the night with live music, fire and pyrotechnics. At least 20 of us—musicians, fire handlers and crew—take part in performances lasting over 45 minutes.

data.name: ShowsSmallDescription
data.value: Designed for intimate celebrations or modest budgets. Around 15 Diaples—performers, musicians and assistants—keep the group's full energy going for roughly 35 minutes.

data.name: ShowsTrasmozCaption
data.value: Trasmoz Witches Fair, a packed square, 2014.

data.name: ShowsAdaptDescription
data.value: Contact us with the needs of your event. Together we'll adapt our resources and scripts to achieve an unforgettable and safe experience for everyone.
